column1: # Interaction steps for the eMMC image: sent by the host runner in order, with
# the expected response after each; the judge verifies the responses in the
# received stream. One command per line, CR-terminated by the sender.
# Read-only checks only, and deliberately no `exit`: an early exit would close
# the shell the round's operator may still want after these.
# The steps are the storage line's own report: the shell lists the command
# tables this image was built with, and `stor info` names the block device the
# registry actually holds - which is the one line that says whether this image
# bound the eMMC and not some other storage driver.
